cheers

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Problem running gists
parts:
It seems that the .tar.gz files that GitHub produces and the built-in untar logic in R are not compatible with each other. Furthermore, the version of tar.exe that comes with Rtools appears not to fix it either.

What a mess. We will see if we can get to the bottom of this and fix it so you don't need to go through all this.
